g.text: Low power solenoid drivers (sol. 9-16): IRLR3110Z logic-level DPAK MOSFETs (14 mOhm), latch U4 output HIGH = ON, clocked by /SOL 3 (J113-11).

g.desc: Low power solenoid drivers (sol. 9-16): IRLR3110Z logic-level DPAK MOSFETs (14 mOhm), latch U4 output HIGH = ON, clocked by /SOL 3 (J113-11).

g.text: Tie-back diodes S3M (SMC, 3 A) to +50V (~70 V DC in the machine): coils in this group can be PWM-held by the firmware, the diode then carries the freewheel current.

g.desc: Tie-back diodes S3M (SMC, 3 A) to +50V (~70 V DC in the machine): coils in this group can be PWM-held by the firmware, the diode then carries the freewheel current.

g.text: Output connectors J127 (playfield, key pin 2), J129 (backbox, sol 9-12, key 3) and J128 (cabinet, sol 13-16, key 4) as on the A-12697. Supply +50V via F104 on J107-2.

g.desc: Output connectors J127 (playfield, key pin 2), J129 (backbox, sol 9-12, key 3) and J128 (cabinet, sol 13-16, key 4) as on the A-12697. Supply +50V via F104 on J107-2.
